shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo ----; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md; echo ----; ls -la /home/sandbox/workspace; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/package.json

find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "=== {}"; cat {}'; echo "=== index.html"; cat index.html; echo "=== tsconfig"; cat tsconfig.json; echo "=== vite"; cat vite.config.ts; ls __agent_eval__; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i -C 3 'i18n' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | rg -n '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

rg -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json; sed -n 305,330p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo "=== i18n README"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md | head -150; echo "=== uikit configure"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -name 'configure*.d.ts' | head; rg -n -i -C 5 'configure|lang' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60

echo "=== configure.d.ts"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; echo "=== i18n d.ts"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; rg -n 'setLang|registerKeyset|keyset\(|onLangChange|subscribe|class I18N|setFallbackLang' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== traps"; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo "=== inspect"; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Select Button Text Card Flex Icon TextInput 2>&1 | head -80; echo "=== eval"; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60; rg -n '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n"' -A4 package-lock.json | head

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Select Text Card Flex Icon 2>&1 | head -60; echo "=== I18N d.ts"; sed -n 60,110p node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts; echo "=== localized components"; rg -l 'addComponentKeysets' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | sed 's#.*/components/##' | sort; echo "=== SRG"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "=== Pagination/Table i18n keysets"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/en.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/i18n/en.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/i18n/en.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput/i18n/en.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/i18n/en.json 2>&1

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo "=== uikit i18n glue"; cat $U/utils/i18n/i18n.js; echo "=== ControlGroupProps"; rg -n -A 14 'interface ControlGroupProps' $U/components/types.d.ts; echo "=== Select"; sed -n 1,200p $U/components/Select/types.d.ts | rg -n 'value\?|onUpdate|options\?|placeholder|filterable|width|label\?|size\?|SelectOption\b|interface SelectProps|multiple|hasClear' | head -30; echo "=== Pagination"; cat $U/components/Pagination/types.d.ts | head -60; echo "=== Table"; rg -n 'data:|columns:|interface TableColumnConfig|interface TableProps|emptyMessage|width\?|verticalAlign|id:|name:|template' $U/components/Table/Table.d.ts | head -30; echo "=== Card"; rg -n 'type\?|view\?|theme\?|size\?|interface CardProps|CardType|CardView' $U/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head; echo "=== Alert"; rg -n 'theme\?|title\?|message\?|onClose\?|view\?|layout\?|corners' $U/components/Alert/types.d.ts | head; echo "=== Text"; rg -n 'variant\?|color\?|ellipsis\?|TEXT_VARIANTS|whiteSpace' $U/components/Text/Text.d.ts $U/components/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== Flex"; rg -n 'direction\?|gap\?|alignItems\?|justifyContent\?|wrap\?|width\?' $U/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; echo "=== Button"; rg -n 'view\?|size\?|onClick|selected\?' $U/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; echo "=== Toaster"; cat $U/components/Toaster/i18n/en.json; rg -n 'add\(|interface ToastProps|theme\?|title\?|content\?|name:' $U/components/Toaster/types.d.ts | head; rg -n 'useToaster|ToasterProvider|ToasterComponent' $U/components/Toaster/index.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; ls $U/utils/i18n/ 2>/dev/null || ls $U/utils | rep -i i18n; cat $U/utils/i18n/index.js 2>/dev/null; cat $U/utils/configure.js; rg -n 'Text\b.*color|TextProps.*color|color\?' $U/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -3; rg -n 'TEXT_COLORS' $U/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -2; echo "=== install"; npm install --save @gravity-ui/i18n@1.8.0 2>&1 | tail -5; rg -n '"@gravity-ui' package.json

rg -n 'subscribeConfigure' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.js' -l | head; f=$(rg -l 'subscribeConfigure\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.js' | grep -v configure.js | head -1); echo "== $f"; cat "$f"

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $U/components/theme/useLang.d.ts; rg -n "theme|SegmentedRadioGroup|Pagination|Table'|Card|Alert|Select'|Text'|layout" $U/index.d.ts $U/components/index.d.ts | head -20; cat $U/components/Pagination/i18n/ru.json; rg -n 'useLang' $U/components/theme/useLang.js >/dev/null && rg -n 'useSyncExternalStore' node_modules/use-sync-external-store/package.json | head -1; ls node_modules/use-sync-external-store >/dev/null && echo shim-ok

cat .gitignore; grep -q '^dist' .gitignore || rm -rf dist; perl -0pi -e "s/    const columns = React\.useMemo\(
        \(\) => \[
            \{id: 'name', name: t\('column_name'\)\},
            \{id: 'status', name: t\('column_status'\)\},
        \],
        // columns depend on the language through \`t\`
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
        \[lang\],
    \);/    const columns = [
        {id: 'name', name: t('column_name')},
        {id: 'status', name: t('column_status')},
    ];/" src/App.tsx; sed -n 14,30p src/App.tsx; npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC-OK; git status --short | grep dist || echo "no dist in tree"
